rendered: The premise is reversed. The document does not report bare Al outperforming carbon/Al at 4 mA/cm^2[1]. The carbon/Al collector performed better, and bare Al electrodes were prone to failure at these currents.[2][3] The authors attribute the bare Al shorting to uneven plating caused by its higher nucleation overpotential, which the carbon layer lowers.[4][5][6][7] The carbon/Al electrodes showed a 45 mV[8] voltage hysteresis at 4 mA/cm^2[9]. The document gives no hysteresis value for bare Al at 4 mA/cm^2[10], because those electrodes failed at these currents, so the size of the difference cannot be determined from this document. The only hysteresis comparison it makes at this current is with earlier Cu electrodes, which reported nearly double the hysteresis.[11]
